package: SOIC-14 (TI D, R-PDSO-G14), body 8.65 mm x 3.91 mm nom
description: Quadruple 2-input positive-NAND gate, 1.65 V to 3.6 V VCC, 5.5 V tolerant inputs, 24 mA output drive at 3.3 V (TI SCAS279R, Feb 2016).

pinout.name: 1A
pinout.notes: Gate 1 input A (D/DB/NS/PW column of the Pin Functions table, sec 6, and the D-package Top View diagram).

pinout.name: 3Y
pinout.notes: Gate 3 output. NOTE: the printed Pin Functions table mislabels this row as TYPE '-' / 'Power Pin'; the D-package pin diagram and the gate-number naming make it gate 3's output. See layout_notes for the table erratum.

pinout.name: 3A
pinout.notes: Gate 3 input A (printed table says 'Gate 4 input' - table description column is shifted).

pinout.name: 3B
pinout.notes: Gate 3 input B (printed table says 'Gate 4 input').

pinout.name: 4A
pinout.notes: Gate 4 input A (printed table says 'Gate 3 input').

pinout.name: 4B
pinout.notes: Gate 4 input B (printed table says 'Gate 3 input').

pinout.name: VCC
pinout.notes: Supply, 1.65 V to 3.6 V operating. NOTE: the printed Pin Functions table mislabels this row as TYPE 'O' / 'Gate 3 output'; the pin diagram shows VCC at pin 14.

decoupling.placement: as close to the VCC pin (14) as possible
decoupling.notes: Sec 11 Power Supply Recommendations: single-supply device -> 0.1 uF bypass; parallel 0.1 uF + 1 uF commonly used to reject different noise frequencies.

land_pattern.notes: From the D (R-PDSO-G14) LAND PATTERN DATA sheet (drawing 4211283-3/E, 08/12), Example Board Layout: 12 x 1.27 mm pitch (7 pads per row), 5.40 mm between the centerlines of the two pad rows. Pad geometry 0.60 mm x 1.55 mm, non-soldermask-defined with solder mask opening 0.07 mm larger all around. Stencil openings 14 x 0.55 mm x 1.50 mm. IPC-7351 recommended for alternate designs.

layout_notes: DATASHEET ERRATUM: in the sec 6 Pin Functions table the TYPE and DESCRIPTION columns are shifted by one row from the 3Y row down - 3Y is printed as 'Power Pin', 3A/3B as 'Gate 4 input', 4A/4B as 'Gate 3 input' and VCC as 'O / Gate 3 output'. The pin NUMBER columns and the D-package Top View diagram are self-consistent and are the authority: 7 = GND, 8 = 3Y, 14 = VCC.
Unused inputs must never float: all unused inputs must be held at VCC or GND (Recommended Operating Conditions note 1; sec 12.1 Layout Guidelines). Outputs may generally be left floating.
Bypass: 0.1 uF as close to the VCC pin as possible; 0.1 uF + 1 uF in parallel commonly used (sec 11).

Output drive at 3.3 V (Recommended Operating Conditions 7.4, VCC = 3 V): IOH = -24 mA, IOL = 24 mA. Sec 9.1: maximum sink and source current is 24 mA; sec 10.1: 24 mA of drive current at 3.3 V, high-speed applications up to 100 MHz.

Output levels at VCC = 3 V (Electrical Characteristics 7.7): VOH >= 2.4 V at IOH = -12 mA and >= 2.2 V at IOH = -24 mA over -40 to 85 C (2.3 V typ at 25 C, 2.0 V over -40 to 125 C); VOL <= 0.55 V at IOL = 24 mA over -40 to 85 C (0.8 V over -40 to 125 C).
Input thresholds at VCC = 2.7 V to 3.6 V (Recommended Operating Conditions 7.4): VIH min 2 V, VIL max 0.8 V. Inputs are overvoltage tolerant to 5.5 V at any valid VCC.

Propagation delay at VCC = 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V (Switching Characteristics 7.9, test load RL = 500 ohm, VLOAD = 6 V, CL = 50 pF, VM = 1.5 V, input tr/tf <= 2.5 ns, Figure 2): tpd A or B -> Y = 1 ns min, 3.5 ns typ at 25 C, 4.1 ns max at 25 C, 4.3 ns max over -40 to 85 C, 5.5 ns max over -40 to 125 C. Output-to-output skew tsk(o) = 1.5 ns max at 3.3 V.

The datasheet does NOT specify an output rise/fall (transition) time or slew rate - only tpd and tsk(o) are characterized. Sec 10.2.1 warns the high drive creates fast edges into light loads, so routing and load conditions must be considered to prevent ringing.

Supply range 1.65 V to 3.6 V (SN74LVC00A); 3.3 V +/- 0.3 V is a fully specified column in 7.9 and VCC = 3 V rows are specified in 7.4/7.7. VCC MAX IS 3.6 V - this part is NOT rated for 5 V rails (inputs/outputs tolerate 5.5 V, the supply does not).
Design limits (sec 10.2.2): load current should not exceed 25 mA per output and 50 mA total for the part; outputs should not be pulled above 5.5 V.
Cpd (power dissipation capacitance per gate) = 19 pF typ at VCC = 3.3 V, f = 10 MHz, TA = 25 C (sec 7.10). Ci = 5 pF at 3.3 V.
Function table, each gate (Table 1): Y = L only when A = H and B = H; any input L forces Y = H.
Thermal: RthJA = 86 C/W for the D (SOIC-14) package (sec 7.5).

abs_max.param: Ptot power dissipation, TA = -40 to 125 C (D package derates 8 mW/K above 70 C)
